# Language-model fine-tuning notebook — review fixes

**Review:** `language_model_finetuning_colab_Review.md` (Notebook Review Framework v1, prefix `LMF`, reviewed commit
`311b3c0`, verdict *Needs revision*; PR #77).
**Sweep record:** `../2026-10-05-fleet-sweep/language_model_finetuning_colab_Fixes.md` (commit `22338c5`: isolated runtime,
guided layer, frozen-base re-runs, `BYOD_PATH`, guarded download).
**Notebook:** `tutorials/language_model_finetuning_colab.ipynb`, regenerated by `tools/build_notebook.py`; `--check` clean.
**Readiness:** **Verification pending.** **Status labels:** unchanged (`Candidate`).

The default path computes the same data, splits, masking, training loop and exports as before; what is added is the base
model's validation loss before adaptation, the per-epoch record, a reload check that says what the artifact reproduces, a
re-runnable Section 9, BYOD split order, prose from the recorded run, and an optional decoding activity. No model stage
ran here.

## User-visible changes

- Section 6 prints `base_validation_loss` / `base_validation_perplexity`; Section 7 prints the base → adapted line;
  `METRICS` gains `baseValidationLoss`, `baseValidationPerplexity`, `epochs`, `reloadedValidationLoss`,
  `reloadedValidationPerplexity`; the evaluation report gains `baselines` entries.
- Section 10 keeps the trained model in memory (about one more 4-bit base copy of GPU memory), reloads into `reloaded`,
  and prints a reproduction line; the result JSON `reload` block and the bundle provenance carry the new fields.
- BYOD without a validation file: hash-ordered before the hold-out (a different, deterministic validation subset than
  the file head).
- New optional activity cell after Section 9 (`RUN_DECODING_EXPERIMENT`, off).
- Spec declaration 2.2; release documents reconciled.
